data.description: SQL编程练习 - 性能优化查询

text:
-- 使用EXPLAIN分析查询性能
EXPLAIN SELECT u.*, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
WHERE u.status = 'active'
GROUP BY u.id;

-- 优化子查询为JOIN
-- 优化前（慢）
SELECT * FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE amount > 1000);

-- 优化后（快）
SELECT DISTINCT u.* FROM users u
INNER JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
WHERE o.amount > 1000;

-- 使用索引提示
SELECT * FROM users USE INDEX (idx_city_status)
WHERE city = '北京' AND status = 'active';

-- 批量插入优化
INSERT INTO logs (user_id, action, created_at)
VALUES
    (1, 'login', NOW()),
    (2, 'logout', NOW()),
    (3, 'purchase', NOW());

-- 分页查询优化
SELECT * FROM orders
WHERE id > 1000
ORDER BY id
LIMIT 20;

-- 避免SELECT *，只查询需要的字段
SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE city = '上海';

-- 使用覆盖索引
CREATE INDEX idx_user_email_name ON users(email, name);
SELECT email, name FROM users WHERE email LIKE '%@gmail.com';
